environment.description: Laravel 10 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate with PHP 8.2-fpm and php-ldap extension. Container runs with default capabilities. LDAP server is OpenLDAP 2.6 on a private subnet accessible from the application container. No input filtering proxy or WAF in front of the application. Routes are exposed via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) with TLS passthrough.

config.network: private VPC, app subnet can reach LDAP on port 389
config.load_balancer: NLB with TLS passthrough, no inspection
